messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- The Ember team does pairing on every production change. [decision; valid 2025-03-19 to now; recorded by standup/ember/2025-03-19-2]
- INC-2026-003 was an incident in which the webhooks service delivered some events twice on 2026-01-17. [valid 2026-01-22 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-003]
- The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails. [valid 2025-04-15 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-15]
- INC-2026-009 was an incident in which the scheduler ran the nightly jobs twice on 2026-05-03. [valid 2026-05-08 to now; recorded by incident-review/INC-2026-009]
- On 2026-03-03, Team Dune's standup decided that the resizer will keep original uploads for 90 days only. [decision; valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- Dashboards and alerts for the resizer are being repointed as of 2025-04-29. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- On 2025-05-19, Team Cinder noticed that the resizer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-05-19 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-05-19-2]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
- As of 2025-04-29, the Ember team has taken over the resizer from Team Dune. [valid 2025-04-29 to now; recorded by handover/2025-04-29-image-resizer]
    earlier: The resizer lives with Team Dune. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-04-29; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-07-03, Team Atlas noticed that the resizer's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade and pinged the owners. [valid 2025-07-03 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-07-03-2]
- As of 2026-03-03, storage for the resizer's original uploads had doubled in six months. [valid 2026-03-03 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-03]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer lives with Team Dune; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
- The billing service depends on the feature-flags service. [valid 2025-09-08 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-09-08-2]
- On 2025-11-07, Farah walked Marcus through the reporting service runbook. [valid 2025-11-07 to now; recorded by handover/2025-11-07-reporting]
- The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents. [valid 2025-02-28 to now; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-02-28]
- The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings. [valid 2025-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-10]
- On 2025-03-17, Team Atlas handed the billing service to Team Boreal. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
- The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens. [valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-03-17]
- The webhooks service ships only on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC. [constraint; valid 2025-03-17 to now; recorded by standup/boreal/2025-03-17]

Question: Which service does image-resizer depend on?

message.reasoning:
The question asks which service the image-resizer depends on. Looking at the memory:

- "The catalog service depends on the resizer for thumbnails." — that's catalog depending on resizer, not resizer depending on something.
- "The billing service depends on the feature-flags service." — not relevant.
- "The billing service depends on the ledger for invoice postings." — not relevant.
- "The ledger depends on the auth gateway for service tokens." — not relevant.
- "The indexer depends on the catalog service for product documents." — not relevant.

There's no entry saying the resizer depends on any service. So the answer is "I don't know".
